- 目標：老師手機在評量頁操作（切 tab、展開列表、開啟/送出表單）體感順暢，尖峰時段也不明顯掉幀。

  - `/api/v1/class-sessions`

### Phase 1：快速止血（2-3 天）

  - 避免在老師評量流程中同步打所有 badge API，改成延後/合併。
- 評量頁減載（不改業務規則）
  - [LearningRecordsPage.vue](/home/admin/frontend/src/pages/LearningRecordsPage.vue) 將首次載入拆成關鍵資料優先（records）與次要資料延後（teacher/students/courses）。
  - 先收斂 `per_page`，加入分頁或漸進載入，避免一次拉滿 200~500 筆。

  - [styles.css](/home/admin/frontend/src/styles.css) 於行動端弱化 blur/backdrop-filter 熱點。

### Phase 2：結構優化（3-5 天）

  - [LearningRecordsPage.vue](/home/admin/frontend/src/pages/LearningRecordsPage.vue) 將重型 `computed`（group/sort/filter）拆分為可快取的分層資料管線。

有可能「同時很多人在線」會讓系統變慢，但你說的「不自動登出所以越來越卡」在這套系統裡比較像**次要因素**。我先快速查一下目前登入 token 是否有到期與清理機制，幫你判斷這個假設的機率。

有可能是「同時在線人數多」造成變慢，但你說的「沒自動登出，累積很多人所以卡」**機率比較低**。

關鍵原因：

- 目前登入 token 不是永久的，有效期 7 天（見 `backend/app/Http/Controllers/AuthController.php`）。
- 每次 API 請求都會檢查 token 是否過期，過期就 401 並刪除（見 `backend/app/Http/Middleware/AttachAuthUser.php`）。
- 同一裝置再次登入時，系統會清掉同裝置舊 token，不會一直疊加（`AuthController` 有 `revokeSameDeviceActiveTokens`）。

所以真正更可能的是：

- **尖峰時段同時請求太多**（不是「登入狀態太多」本身）：
  - 主框架有固定輪詢 badge/通知（`frontend/src/App.vue`）
  - 聊天與其他頁面也有輪詢
  - 老師評量頁初次會打多支 API 且一次拉較多資料（`frontend/src/pages/LearningRecordsPage.vue`）

一句話：**卡頓比較像「同時在線 + 高頻輪詢 + 大資料載入」的壓力，而不是「沒自動登出」本身。**

<?php

namespace App\Http\Middleware;

use Closure;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class LogSlowRequests
{
    /**
     * Slow-request threshold in milliseconds.
     * Requests exceeding this are logged at warning level.
     */
    private const SLOW_THRESHOLD_MS = 800;

    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next)
    {
        $start = microtime(true);
        $traceId = substr(bin2hex(random_bytes(8)), 0, 16);
        $request->attributes->set('trace_id', $traceId);

        $response = $next($request);

        $durationMs = round((microtime(true) - $start) * 1000, 1);

        $response->headers->set('X-Trace-Id', $traceId);
        $response->headers->set('X-Response-Time', $durationMs . 'ms');
        $response->headers->set('Server-Timing', "total;dur={$durationMs}");

        $path = $request->path();
        $method = $request->method();
        $status = $response->getStatusCode();
        $role = $request->attributes->get('auth_role', 'anon');

        $context = [
            'trace_id'    => $traceId,
            'method'      => $method,
            'path'        => $path,
            'status'      => $status,
            'duration_ms' => $durationMs,
            'role'        => $role,
            'branch_id'   => $request->input('branch_id'),
        ];

        if ($durationMs >= self::SLOW_THRESHOLD_MS) {
            Log::channel('single')->warning("[slow-request] {$method} /{$path} {$durationMs}ms", $context);
        }

        // Always log high-frequency perf-critical endpoints
        $perfEndpoints = [
            'api/v1/learning-records',
            'api/v1/notifications/unread-count',
            'api/v1/class-sessions',
        ];
        foreach ($perfEndpoints as $ep) {
            if (str_starts_with($path, $ep)) {
                Log::channel('single')->info("[perf-endpoint] {$method} /{$path} {$durationMs}ms", $context);
                break;
            }
        }

        return $response;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Middleware;

use Closure;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class LogSlowRequests
{
    private const SLOW_THRESHOLD_MS = 800;

    /**
     * SLO thresholds (P95 targets) per endpoint prefix.
     * If a single request exceeds the P95 target, log as SLO warning.
     */
    private const SLO_THRESHOLDS = [
        'api/v1/learning-records'          => 1200,
        'api/v1/notifications/unread-count' => 300,
        'api/v1/class-sessions'            => 800,
        'api/v1/students'                  => 600,
        'api/v1/student-classes'           => 800,
    ];

    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next)
    {
        $start = microtime(true);
        $traceId = substr(bin2hex(random_bytes(8)), 0, 16);
        $request->attributes->set('trace_id', $traceId);

        $response = $next($request);

        $durationMs = round((microtime(true) - $start) * 1000, 1);

        $response->headers->set('X-Trace-Id', $traceId);
        $response->headers->set('X-Response-Time', $durationMs . 'ms');
        $response->headers->set('Server-Timing', "total;dur={$durationMs}");

        $path = $request->path();
        $method = $request->method();
        $status = $response->getStatusCode();
        $role = $request->attributes->get('auth_role', 'anon');

        $context = [
            'trace_id'    => $traceId,
            'method'      => $method,
            'path'        => $path,
            'status'      => $status,
            'duration_ms' => $durationMs,
            'role'        => $role,
            'branch_id'   => $request->input('branch_id'),
        ];

        if ($durationMs >= self::SLOW_THRESHOLD_MS) {
            Log::channel('single')->warning("[slow-request] {$method} /{$path} {$durationMs}ms", $context);
        }

        // SLO tracking for monitored endpoints
        foreach (self::SLO_THRESHOLDS as $prefix => $threshold) {
            if (str_starts_with($path, $prefix)) {
                Log::channel('perf')->info('perf_metric', $context);

                if ($durationMs > $threshold) {
                    $context['slo_threshold_ms'] = $threshold;
                    Log::channel('perf')->warning("[slo-breach] {$method} /{$path} {$durationMs}ms > {$threshold}ms", $context);
                }

                if ($status >= 500) {
                    Log::channel('perf')->error("[server-error] {$method} /{$path} status={$status}", $context);
                }
                break;
            }
        }

        return $response;
    }
}
